# KMU-Portal des SECO

> > Switzerland's official SME portal providing comprehensive support for business founding, financing, management, and succession planning across all four national languages.

The KMU-Portal (SME Portal) is operated by SECO (State Secretariat for Economic Affairs) and serves as a central hub for Swiss small and medium-sized enterprises. It offers resources on business setup, financing options, management guidance, and succession planning, with content available in German, French, Italian, and English.

## Key Topics

- SECO
- SME support
- Business founding
- Business financing
- Business management
- Succession planning
- Swiss business
- M&A
- Exports
- COVID-19 credits
- Business resources
- Tourism statistics
- Export data
- Business information

## Portal Home & Core

- [KMU-Portal des SECO (German)](https://www.kmu.admin.ch/kmu/de/home.html): SECO SME portal for business founding, financing, management and succession planning
- [Portail PME du SECO (French)](https://www.kmu.admin.ch/kmu/fr/home.html): Portail PME SECO pour création, financement et gestion d'entreprise
- [Portale PMI della SECO (Italian)](https://www.kmu.admin.ch/kmu/it/home.html): Portale PMI SECO per fondazione, finanziamento e gestione aziendale
- [SME portal of SECO (English)](https://www.kmu.admin.ch/kmu/en/home.html): SECO SME portal for business setup, financing, management and succession
